name: window.move
description: Move and/or resize a window by handle. Affects existing window state — classified U.

handle.description: Window handle from window.list, e.g. 'win:0x1A2B' or 'mac:42'.

x.description: New x position in virtual-screen coordinates.

y.description: New y position in virtual-screen coordinates.

w.description: New width in pixels. If omitted, width is preserved.

h.description: New height in pixels. If omitted, height is preserved.

windows-modern.description: SetWindowPos / MoveWindow against the supplied HWND. UIPI may reject moves against higher-IL windows — returns ERR uipi_blocked.

windows-classic.description: Same Win32 APIs (available since NT 3.1). No UIPI, so cross-process moves are not blocked at the kernel boundary.
